# Compliance

Per-country compliance rules (stop keywords, quiet hours, content rules) and the workspace suppression list. For developers who need to check what will be blocked or deferred, or to manage opt-outs programmatically.

Back to the [API reference index](README.md). Shared shapes are in [Schemas](schemas.md); conventions (auth headers, errors, pagination, idempotency) are in the [index](README.md#conventions).

| Method | Path | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | [`/v1/content-rules`](#get-v1content-rules) | List enabled content rules |
| GET | [`/v1/compliance/suppressions`](#get-v1compliancesuppressions) | List suppressions |
| POST | [`/v1/compliance/suppressions`](#post-v1compliancesuppressions) | Add suppression; owner/admin session or compliance:manage key |
| GET | [`/v1/countries/{iso2}/compliance`](#get-v1countriesiso2compliance) | Get public messaging compliance rules for a country |
| POST | [`/v1/compliance/suppressions/import`](#post-v1compliancesuppressionsimport) | Import suppressions as JSON; owner/admin session |
| DELETE | [`/v1/compliance/suppressions/{id}`](#delete-v1compliancesuppressionsid) | Remove workspace suppression; owner/admin session |
| GET | [`/v1/compliance/countries`](#get-v1compliancecountries) | Read compliance country information |
| GET | [`/v1/compliance/countries/{iso2}`](#get-v1compliancecountriesiso2) | Read compliance country information |

## GET /v1/content-rules

**List enabled content rules**

Operation ID: `listContentRules`. Tag: `Compliance`.

Read-only view of the enabled platform content rules (global and per-country) so customers know what will be held or rejected. Message release stays admin-only: to contest a hold, contact support with the message id; operators review it at POST /admin/v1/messages/held/{id}/release.

**Auth:** API key with scope `compliance:read`, or session token (`Authorization: Bearer sess_...`).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Workspace-ID` | header | string (uuid) | no |  | Required with a session bearer token. Must identify an undeleted workspace where the active user is a member. API keys use their own workspace and ignore this header. |
| `X-Environment` | header | string | no |  | Required with a session bearer token. API keys use their own environment and ignore this header. One of: `sandbox`, `live`. |

**Request body:** none.

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `200` | Enabled content rules. | `application/json`: array of [ContentRule](schemas.md#contentrule) |
| `400` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `401` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `403` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X GET "$OPENSMS_API/v1/content-rules" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_test_VG0...'
```

Response `200` (`application/json`):

```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "country_iso2": "KE",
    "kind": "blocked_keyword",
    "pattern": "loan",
    "action": "hold_for_review",
    "traffic_types": ["marketing", "transactional"],
    "enabled": true
  },
  {
    "id": 2,
    "country_iso2": "NG",
    "kind": "blocked_keyword",
    "pattern": "loan",
    "action": "hold_for_review",
    "traffic_types": ["marketing", "transactional"],
    "enabled": true
  },
  {
    "id": 3,
    "country_iso2": "KE",
    "kind": "blocked_keyword",
    "pattern": "betting",
    "action": "hold_for_review",
    "traffic_types": ["marketing", "transactional"],
    "enabled": true
  }
]
```

## GET /v1/compliance/suppressions

**List suppressions**

Operation ID: `listSuppressions`. Tag: _none in contract_.

Browser sessions require explicit X-Workspace-ID and X-Environment. API keys remain bound to their stored workspace and environment. See docs/frontend-contract.md for operation roles and workspace-global resources.

**Auth:** API key with scope `compliance:read`, or session token (`Authorization: Bearer sess_...`).

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | query | integer | no | `50` | Constraints: minimum `1`, maximum `200`. |
| `cursor` | query | string | no |  | Opaque cursor returned by the previous page for this collection and workspace. Constraints: maxLength `2048`. |

## POST /v1/compliance/suppressions

**Add suppression; owner/admin session or compliance:manage key**

| `X-Environment` | header | string | no |  | Required with a session bearer token. API keys use their own environment and ignore this header. One of: `sandbox`, `live`. |

**Request body** (`application/json`, required)
